jobs.title: Wholesale Launch Strategy
jobs.request: Launch our wholesale line to Portland cafes. We need a launch plan, a wholesale page on our Shopify store, outreach emails to 40 cafes, and product photos for the wholesale catalogue.
jobs.brief:
Create a wholesale launch plan, build a Shopify wholesale page, write outreach emails to 40 Portland-area cafes, and produce original product photos for the wholesale catalog. All content must reflect Northwind’s warm, plain, and slightly nerdy voice—naming farms and processes, avoiding exclamation marks and overhyped language. Align with current delivery zones (Portland, Beaverton, Lake Oswego), pricing, minimums, and cupping call-to-action.

submissions.content:
Northwind Coffee: Wholesale Launch Plan

Who we sell to
Independent cafes in Portland, Beaverton and Lake Oswego with one to three locations and a pour-over or batch-brew bar.

The offer
Small-batch single origins in 5 lb bags with a 10 lb minimum per order. Orders close Friday noon, we roast Monday and deliver every Tuesday in Portland, Beaverton and Lake Oswego. Standing weekly orders over 30 lb get 5% off. Every outreach message names the farm and the process, for example a washed Ethiopian from the Hambela farm.

Launch timeline
Week 1 (from 1 December): tasting kits to 40 cafes, delivered by hand.
Week 2: follow-up calls, and Thursday morning cuppings at the roastery.
Week 3: first orders and the wholesale page live on Shopify.
Week 4: review who ordered twice, and why the others did not.

Risks
1. Roasting capacity above 300 lb a week needs a second roast day.
2. One delivery driver; a backup courier is booked for weeks 3 and 4.

submissions.content:
Northwind Coffee: Wholesale Launch Plan

Who we sell to
Independent cafes in Portland, Beaverton and Lake Oswego with one to three locations and a pour-over or batch-brew bar.

The offer
Small-batch single origins in 5 lb bags with a 10 lb minimum per order. Orders close Friday noon, we roast Monday and deliver every Tuesday in Portland, Beaverton and Lake Oswego. Standing weekly orders over 30 lb get 5% off. Every outreach message names the farm and the process, for example a washed Ethiopian from the Hambela farm.

Launch timeline
Week 1 (from 1 December): tasting kits to 40 cafes, delivered by hand.
Week 2: follow-up calls, and Thursday morning cuppings at the roastery.
Week 3: first orders and the wholesale page live on Shopify.
Week 4: review who ordered twice, and why the others did not.

Risk register
1. Roasting capacity above 300 lb a week needs a second roast day.
2. One delivery driver; a backup courier is booked for weeks 3 and 4.
3. Green coffee arrives late; keep three weeks of stock.
4. Cafes order once and stop; a call after the second week.
5. Stale bags on long routes; deliver within 48 hours of roasting.
6. Price pressure from larger roasters; lead with origin, not price.
7. Sample cost runs over; cap at 40 kits.
8. Shopify wholesale page slips; take orders by email until it is live.
9. Cuppings draw few people; add a Saturday slot.
10. Refund claims rise; track each against its delivery route.

chunks.text:
Northwind Coffee: Brand and Wholesale
Guide
Voice
We write the way we talk at the roaster: warm, plain and a little nerdy about where the coffee grew. We
name the farm and the process. We never say supercharge, elevate or game-changer, and we never use
exclamation marks.
Wholesale terms
Cafes order 5 lb bags with a 10 lb minimum per order. Orders placed by Friday noon are roasted
Monday and delivered on Tuesday in Portland. Single origins are 13.50 dollars per pound. Standing
weekly orders over 30 lb get 5 percent off.
Returns and refunds
If a bag arrives stale or damaged, tell us within 14 days and we replace it or refund it, whichever the
cafe prefers. We do not charge for return shipping.
Photography
Natural light only, beans and hands in frame, no stock photos and no latte art close-ups.
